sentences.text:
Child Marriage Act vs Allowed on 19 September, 2023
19.09.2023
 tkm/ct 28 C.R.M. (Db) 3451 of 2023
sl no. 36

In Re : An application for bail under section 439 of the Code of Criminal  Procedure in connection with Baruipur P.S case no. 1496 of 2022  dated 14.9.2022 under sections 363/365 IPC adding section 6 of the  POCSO Act, charge framed under sections 363/366/376(2)(n) IPC read  with section 6 of the POCSO Act red with section 9 of the Prohibition of  Child Marriage Act  and Allowed  In Re : Kartick Sardar @ Naskar ... petitioner  Mr. Apalak Basu  Mr. N Ahmed  Ms. S Mridha  ...... for the petitioner  Mr. N Ahmed  Ms. Trina Mitra  ...... for the State  Ms. Manasi Roy  ...... for the victim girl  1.
Petitioner submits there was a love affair between him and the de facto complainant.
2. Learned lawyer for the State opposes the bail prayer.
3. Ms. Roy appears on behalf of the minor victim.
4. We have considered the materials on record.
Minor victim and her mother have been examined.
It appears that there was a love affair between two young persons.

5. Under such circumstances and in view of the period of detention suffered by the petitioner i.e.
324 days, we are inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.

6. Accordingly, the petitioner be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs. 10,000/- with two sureties of like amount each, one of whom must be local to the satisfaction of the learned Judge,
Special Court under POCSO Act, Baruipur, South 24 Parganas on condition that the petitioner shall appear before the trial court on every date of hearing and shall not intimidate witnesses or tamper Child Marriage Act vs Allowed on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/132566983/
1 with evidence in any manner whatsoever.
7. In the event he fails to appear before the trial court without justifiable cause, the trial court shall be at liberty to cancel his bail automatically without reference to this court.
8. The application being CRM (DB) 3451 of 2023 is disposed of.

(Ajoy Kumar Mukherjee, J.) (Joymalya Bagchi, J.)
